authorization: Project owner explicitly instructed implementation of the approved agricultural legacy plan after reviewing and selecting the 1961 incremental initialization option.

immutable_parent.preservation_rule: Do not edit or overwrite the parent lock, report, parameters or product.

primary_hypothesis: Explicit manure-organic and internally recycled crop-residue N stored in Fresh and Protected agricultural SON pools can be coupled to the frozen hydrology without violating mass conservation and without degrading transferable TN prediction.
primary_goal: Build, audit and evaluate a monthly 1961-2024 Fresh/Protected agricultural N legacy scenario; promote it only if the preregistered temporal and spatial production gates pass.
formal_hydrology: Frozen 20260828_9/10 state-consistent quick/slow interface and its registered 1961-2009 reconstruction.
formal_tn_observations: Frozen 20260824_18 river-channel TN registry; 2021-2024 development with the existing three temporal OOF folds and nested spatial holdouts.
allowed_new_structure: crop product/residue uptake bookkeeping with internal residue return
fixed literature-bracketed FP-FAST, FP-CENTRAL and FP-SLOW kinetic profiles
allowed_fitted_parameters: the existing P1 log_alpha_contact, beta_contact, v_f, delta_path, beta_low, beta_high and log_sigma
the existing P2 ridge=12 station-history intercept for previously monitored stations only

initialization.main: Fresh=0 and Protected=0 immediately before 1961-01; parent-consistent mineral/lower short states remain parameter dependent.
initialization.prehistory_sensitivity: 50 and 100 kg N/ha of registered 1961 agricultural area, split 25% Fresh and 75% Protected, capped by Reach at 5% of SoilGrids 0-100 cm total N; never used for model selection.

forbidden: TN-selected expansion of the Fresh/Protected kinetic grid
free crop-residue return or manure mineral fractions selected from TN
SAS, fitted groundwater age, dual groundwater store or empirical output TN lag
station, Reach or tree identity in P1
overwriting the 20260824_32 production lock or product

execution_boundary.successors: Create only the minimum subsequent 20260824_* stages needed for data QA, core tests, OOF/spatial evaluation, sensitivity and final locking. Every successor must be registered here before reading its TN result.
execution_boundary.stop: Stop after a final scenario or production decision; no automatic structural expansion.
